title: Dungeon Route Budget
brief: In our dungeon crawler, levels are generated as a binary tree of TreeNode rooms, each holding a score change that can be positive or negative. A quest is completable if a player can walk from the entrance at the root down to a dead-end room with no exits and finish with a total of exactly the quest's target.

Implement hasExactRoute(root, targetSum), where root is the entrance room and targetSum is the quest target, and return true if some route from the root to a room with no children adds up to exactly targetSum, and false otherwise.
